Overlay draws only in Setup mode and only on the selected view. 12 unit tests via fakeDom plus 3 e2e. No new dependency; controller is 154 lines, well under the interact.js threshold.

New src/render/backgroundCrop.js resolves a view's background image and, for a backgroundFrom detail view, the patch of it to show. Consumed twice: viewConfig.js sets background-size/-position on the panel (and clears both when a view stops borrowing, since panels are reused by id), and app.js passes the same rect to captureViewToPng as a sourceRect so the exported PNG shows the same patch instead of the whole photo stretched. The crop is derived by mapping the detail's corners through the SOURCE view's transform, which handles mirrored elevations and the plan y-flip for free. normalizeProjectConfig now rejects backgroundFrom across differing type/viewFrom, and the Setup panel only offers compatible sources. tests/backgroundCrop.test.js covers the worked example, the equal-extent and full-width guards, and both mirrored and unmirrored elevations. Export loop over views[] was already in place from nl-tz7.4; crop backgrounds were the missing piece.

Two-point ruler shipped. resolveRulerCalibration + measureRuler in src/render/setupOverlay.js solve extentFt from a drag across the background photo and a typed real length; setupController gains setRuler()/onRuler (the armed pointer measures instead of moving handles); setupPanel gains the Measure a known length toggle, the px/ft readout, and the length field; app.js holds the segment in appState.ruler and clears it before the rebuild. Unit tests cover the solve on a plan and on a mirrored (north) elevation — asserting the near edge and ground line keep their fraction of the photo — plus diagonal equivalence and the misclick/nonsense-length guards. One e2e spec measures half the plan panel and asserts Width (ft) doubles the typed length. Two bugs found by that spec and fixed: the pointer's last position is now held outside the rAF-throttled payload (a release after a flushed frame measured zero), and the panel only learns the measurement on drag end (growing it mid-gesture shifted the canvas under the pointer). AGENTS.md documents the gesture and the anchoring rule.
